bioconda.name: samcut
bioconda.summary: samcut is `cut` for sam. Select (cut) columns from the output of `samtools view` using human-readale field names.

commands:
VER=$(samcut -V)
if [ "$VER" = "samcut 0.1.1" ]; then
  echo "Version check: OK"
else
  echo "Version check: FAIL (expected: 'samcut 0.1.1' | actual: '$VER' )"
  exit 1
fi
